record.question: Pick out the correct answers which relate to Special Casual Leave:
record.explanation: Defective item: the printed paper (p.2) shows this as a multi-select worth 5 marks with eight options (a)-(h); the bank captured only (a)-(d), dropping (e) Vacation Departments, (f) Cultural activities, (g) Trekking Expeditions, (h) Sports events. Under CCS (Leave) Rules Rule 29-B, Special Casual Leave relates to competitive examinations, cultural activities, sports events including trekking expeditions, and participation through National Sports Federation bodies, so both 'Competitive Examinations' and 'National Sports Federation' among the supplied options are correct while 'Bond in Form 7' and 'Leave Salary' are not. With two correct supplied options and no unique single answer possible, the item is held; repair requires restoring the printed options (e)-(h) and a multi-answer format.
